_help: Texts of the order tracking page (/track/) and the order statuses. Orders themselves are kept in the Cloudflare database and changed on /admin/orders/.

seo.title: Track your order
seo.description: Check the status of your order from Arafat Bin Wahahid with your order ID and the last 4 digits of your phone number or your email.

hero.title: Track your order
hero.text: Enter your order ID and the last 4 digits of your phone number (or your email) to see where your order is.

idHint: Shown after you ordered and in your WhatsApp or email, e.g. AB-261023-K7Q2M
checkLabel: Last 4 digits of your phone, or your email
notFound: No order matches this order ID and phone or email. Check both and try again, or message me on WhatsApp.
unavailable: Order tracking is not available right now. Please message me on WhatsApp with your order ID.
tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.

statuses.label: Order received
statuses.text: We have your order and will check the payment.

statuses.label: Payment confirmed
statuses.text: Your payment is confirmed. Your order is in the queue.

statuses.label: Delivered
statuses.text: Your order is delivered. Thank you!

statuses.label: Cancelled
statuses.text: This order was cancelled. Message me on WhatsApp if this is a mistake.
